# EMILIA Protocol vectors (third-party test fixtures)

`receipts.v1.json` and `outcome-binding.v1.json` are copied unchanged from
[emiliaprotocol/emilia-protocol](https://github.com/emiliaprotocol/emilia-protocol), `conformance/vectors/`, at commit
`611483b` (12 November 2026). Their SHA-256 digests match the ones pinned in that repository's
`conformance/conformance-manifest.json`:

- `receipts.v1.json`: `e27b31759c9c901f5cd6e2986758a249175ea14dbc818e401d42fb71280aa83b`
- `outcome-binding.v1.json`: `c549c9fc53eab2e716dfb0f20957a84dd80f8cf263f8b3d8a51d86f5f3ed8152`

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; the licence text is in `LICENSE` here. They are used to test AMEP's
EP profile against the vectors' own expected results.
